Carries checked session identities, provider URLs and transport settings through the runtime. Rust integrations should retain these checked values instead of converting them back to strings or validating them again.

Background shell commands support an explicit initial wait and immediate background execution, with completion notices delivered to their owning session. Provider text before a tool call is retained as commentary; explicit provider phases remain unchanged. OpenRouter requests use a bounded output allowance and project attribution. Sandbox failures explain why an operation was refused without weakening filesystem protection.

Wire protocol 95, configuration 29, Bot state 9, checkpoint 20 and SQLite schema 13 are unchanged. Existing state needs no conversion from 0.16.40.
